items.name: mutmut
items.purpose: Bounded mutation testing of Orchestra trust-boundary modules during release-confidence hardening. Incomplete tool execution is preserved as evidence rather than converted into a score.
incorporated_or_learned_patterns: Treat mutation confidence as scope-specific evidence and require a complete baseline and mutation session before reporting a score.

evidence.description: Existing re-foundation test-tool provenance retained and enriched.

items.name: Cosmic Ray
